Filed by the family member 5 dev of #15379 (session `session_019RfFHiRCSs3JXLK4cwcfox`, branch `claude/issue-15379-agents-claude-rules-only`, PR #15856) as an out-of-scope finding. Unassigned, no labels — a concrete documentation defect for triage to grade. `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` is a governed surface (draft PR, human merge) and was member 4's file (PR #15725), so it is not touched by member 5.

## What

`.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (section 字节与 sanitizer 纪律, the footer lines right after the two-form footer block) still states the PR-body edit reading that #15241 falsified:

- `session 形按 create-only 对待:PATCH 编辑把它降回裸形。`
- `耐久归属写进正文散文或评论,⛔ 不循环重贴页脚;完整读数住 AGENTS.md 同条。`

PR #15856 (#15241's carrier) rewrites the AGENTS.md sentence it points at to the measured form: on an edit (`update_pull_request` or a REST PATCH, measured in this repository) the session-URL footer survives verbatim and the platform appends a bare footer block under whatever is sent — so an edited body is sent with no footer of its own and read back. Once that PR lands, the two surfaces disagree on the fact, while os-dev.md's own text names AGENTS.md as the full reading.

## Measured

- PR #15856 body: sent 23026 bytes with the session-URL footer, stored 23026 bytes, byte-identical on the create path (`GET /pulls/15856` read-back).
- #15241 body and its second measurement comment: two independent devs, two tools, three-to-one against the "normalises DOWN to bare" reading; #15246 (closed) is a third reading in the same direction.
- The #15241 first-touch disposition said the os-dev.md mirror would follow in the os-dev.md member; PR #15725 landed the rules-only rewrite of that file with the old reading kept.

## Ask

Align the one os-dev.md line with the measured AGENTS.md form (session form survives an edit; the platform appends a bare block; send an edited body with no footer and read it back) — one line, inside the file's ratchet ceiling (0 headroom today, so paid by merging an adjacent line), in a governed draft PR. No change to AGENTS.md is needed after PR #15856.
